Texas hold'em it is: heads-up against me. We each get two hole cards, then three shared cards on the flop, one on the turn and one on the river. There's a round of betting before each of those. Your best five-card hand out of the seven wins the pot.

You start with 1,000 chips. We each put in a 10-chip ante, so the pot is 20 and your count is now 990. You have Q♥ 10♥, which is suited, connected and strong. You act first: check, bet the amount on the slider, or fold.
